deskyard share create: share a computer by link

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] share create COMPUTER NAME [OPTIONS]

Shares a computer you have full access to: makes the account NAME with access
to it only, and prints its login link, which works once. Observe-only shares
watch in a browser and can't use the CLI. The share ends when it is revoked or
expires, or when you lose full access.

Arguments:
  COMPUTER   string      required  computer name
  NAME       string      required  the share's username, e.g. who it is for

Options:
  --observe            observe only: watch the desktop, no input
  --expires WHEN       when the share ends: a time from now (90m, 2h, 7d, 2w)
                       or an RFC 3339 time
  --server NAME        the server to manage (see `deskyard server list`);
                       default: the server -c SERVER/COMPUTER names, else the
                       default server

Prints: the login link (https://host/link#dyl_…) alone on stdout; what it
  gives on stderr

Examples:
  deskyard share create alice sanne --observe --expires 1d
  link=$(deskyard share create alice pair)

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
